experiments.name: happy_path
experiments.result: Both complete with successful task states. ETL quarantined 1070 source rows; ELT audit counted 542 rejected current order rows after the bad-row experiment was retained in append-only raw history. Clean-order reconciliation matches at 211 exceptions, including 11 amount mismatches totaling INR 560.00 absolute difference.

experiments.name: rerun_idempotency
experiments.result: Repeated runs retained 2013 ETL fact rows and the same 1827 delivered orders / INR 985561.65 in the ELT current mart; ELT raw history appended each run.

experiments.name: increment
experiments.result: The incremental file contains 160 rows: 150 new order IDs and 10 corrections. Both final current-state outputs match after processing the increment.

experiments.name: missing_source
experiments.result: Temporarily removing products.csv put extract_products (ETL) and extract_sources (ELT) into retry. Restoring the file allowed each task to succeed on try 2; both runs completed.

experiments.name: five_bad_rows
experiments.result: Five synthetic defects exercised completeness, validity, referential integrity, and timeliness checks. Both runs completed and their DQ records showed the injected failures; the source file was restored.

experiments.name: schema_change
experiments.result: Renaming order_amount to order_total failed ETL validate_sources and ELT extract_sources. ELT audit marked the run failed. After restoring the header and correcting the expected customer column to full_name, clearing the run recovered it successfully.

experiments.name: volume_50
experiments.result: Both runs completed and recorded orders_volume_min_500 as WARN for the 50-row source.

experiments.name: price_distribution_drift
experiments.result: A 100x price mutation for S08 produced orders_unit_price_distribution warnings (167 ETL and 159 ELT findings) and moved S08 revenue to INR 6932735.90.

experiments.name: stale_30_day_source
experiments.result: The maximum order timestamp was set to 30 days before each run. ETL emitted orders_freshness_within_one_day and increment freshness warnings; ELT emitted orders_freshness_within_one_day WARN after its rule was fixed to ignore future-dated rows.

experiments.name: clear_and_recovery
experiments.result: After the schema defect was removed, Airflow task instances were cleared. ETL and ELT reran the DAG tasks to success; the ELT test also confirmed that a failed audit task leaves the DAG run failed.
